verdict.rationale: The official Angular CLI documents an e2e command that builds and serves the application through the dev server and then runs end-to-end tests, so dev-server integration is first-party (angular-docs-12). However, the evidence does not name which e2e test runner is bundled or whether one works out of the box without extra setup. The only tool named is Protractor, and only from an old AngularJS-era community comment (angular-comm-9). Missing for 10: identification of the official/bundled e2e test runner, evidence that it works out of the box without adding third-party builders, in-depth e2e setup docs, independent hands-on corroboration for modern Angular.
